summary: Plan v55: frozen guard approach — prove chronicle_gap_contradiction via construction-specific guard freezing from U(⊤,⊥) processing. When C5 eliminates U(⊤,⊥) at point a, ⊥ enters guard g(a,a'), preventing any future domain insertions between a and a'. This freezes succ(a) constructively, enabling well-founded induction for succ_cofinal. Immune to Z+Z counterexample (construction-specific, not abstract).
